# Northwind Signal

> Northwind Signal is a fictional AI marketing platform (concept demo by Charlene Cordero, sample content). It offers an Industry Analysis Agent, a B2B Social Media Manager and an AI Content Studio, with human approval before publishing.

## Pages
- [Home](https://chai-nextjs-demo.pages.dev/): overview, how it works, sample pricing, FAQ
- [Features](https://chai-nextjs-demo.pages.dev/features/): the three agents in detail
- [Pricing](https://chai-nextjs-demo.pages.dev/pricing/): Starter $49/mo, Growth $149/mo, Scale custom (sample prices)
- [Contact](https://chai-nextjs-demo.pages.dev/contact/): book a demo
